liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Scarlet Begonias features Jerry reaching high musical heights; Scarlet Begonias solos are described as blowing the listener away [15][21][23]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Shakedown and Estimated Prophet are highlighted as strong performances [13]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Ramble On Rose is considered the best version the listener has heard [14]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Listener loves the Terrapin, Estimated Prophet, and Throwing Stones [19]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Good Lovin' is the star of the post-drums section [15]
- **Terrapin** (1 review): Terrapin is noted as one of the better performances seen [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-09-08.set1-aud.set2-sbd.84856.flac** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 172 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1983-09-08.176442.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 176 min [2]
- **gd1983-09-08.111728.Sennheiser421.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 173 min [4]
- **gd83-09-08.sennheiser.dodd.12482.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 175 min; rated 4.27/5 by 15 [7]. Said about its sound: Recording sounds pretty good but performance is a bit sloppy [13]
- **gd1983-09-08.nakcm304.mikeg-suraci.79047.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 159 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [11]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is outstanding, clear, and crisp with Phil prominent [23]
- **gd83-09-08.set2.sbd.lemieux-kaplan.20536.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 114 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [12]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording has significant crowd noise despite decent quality [17]

## Around the show

- Listener jumped a fence to pee and witnessed intense musical energy [16]
- Reviewer prefers the September 6th show over this one [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-09-08.set1-aud.set2-sbd.84856.flac**: source: Set 1: Nakamichi CM304's > Sony D5 > Sony D6 (shnid=79047)--Tuning before Shakedown & L.L. Rain patches: Senn. 441s? > MC > DAT > CDR (shnid=12482) Set 2: MSC… [1]
- **gd1983-09-08.176442.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [2]. Also: Nakamichi 700 source patches transitions in Brown-Eyed Women, Terrapin, and Space [2]
- **gd1983-09-08.111728.Sennheiser421.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: source: 2 Sennheiser 421 microphones > Sony TC-D5M - master analog cassettes; [4]
- **gd83-09-08.sennheiser.dodd.12482.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD (Senn. 441Âs)> MC> DAT> CDR [7]
- **gd1983-09-08.nakcm304.mikeg-suraci.79047.flac16**: taped by Mike G. and Tony Suraci; transferred by Tony Suraci; source: Nakamich CM304's>Sony D5>Sony D6 At SBD, stand at 7 Feet. [11]
- **gd83-09-08.set2.sbd.lemieux-kaplan.20536.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [12]
